name: VisualSoft3D
detailed_description:
VisualSoft3D is a sleek and efficient 3D model viewer tailored specifically for .obj files.

Designed with simplicity and performance in mind, this tool allows you to effortlessly load, view, and explore intricate 3D models.

Whether you're a designer, developer, or 3D enthusiast, VisualSoft3D provides a seamless experience for inspecting .obj files with high fidelity and precision.

Its minimalist interface ensures that you can focus entirely on your models without distractions.

legal_notice:
Privacy Policy

Effective Date: 18/01/2025

VisualSoft3D ("the App") is developed by Digital Fox ("we," "our," or "us"). This privacy policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your data when you use our App.

1. Information We Do Not Collect
The App does not collect, store, or transmit any personal data, usage data, or device information. All data related to the 3D models you view or load within the App is processed locally on your device.

2. Data Usage
The App is designed to operate entirely offline. Any 3D model files (.obj) you open in the App are not uploaded, shared, or stored on any external servers. All processing is done on your local machine, ensuring the privacy and security of your files.

3. Permissions
The App may request access to your file system to allow you to browse and open 3D model files. This access is used solely for the functionality of the App and does not transmit any data outside your device.

4. Third-Party Services
The App does not integrate with any third-party services or use any third-party analytics tools.

5. Changes to This Privacy Policy
We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted within the App or on our website digitalfox.fr, along with the updated effective date. Continued use of the App after changes to the policy signifies your acceptance of the revised policy.

6. Contact Us
If you have any questions or concerns about this privacy policy or the App, please contact us at:

Email: contact@digitalfox.fr
